headline: Depth Over *Noise* This Week
intro: This issue gathers criticism, profiles and reported essays from across art, film, tech, literature, music, design and fashion. We favor pieces that linger — retrospectives, interviews, and cultural investigations over announcements. A wide geographic and disciplinary spread, built for slow reading.
